items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is that the operation of capping with a first Chern class is well defined on rational equivalence classes at source lines 3326-3335, label lemma-factors, whose proof occupies source lines 3337-3370. The proof is a reduction in two steps: a rationally trivial cycle is written as the pushforward of a sum of principal divisors from the coproduct of the subspaces occurring in the rational equivalence, and the compatibility of the cap operation with proper pushforward descends the claim to that coproduct, after which only an integral space carrying the divisor of one rational function remains. The final step is an identification rather than a computation: the rational function is viewed as a meromorphic section of the structure sheaf and the commutativity of caps on an integral space replaces the given invertible sheaf by the structure sheaf, whose first Chern class is trivial, the last step using additivity in the sheaf. The counted statement records neither the coproduct reduction nor the identification.
